editorial.title: The Weierstrass Two-Torsion Coprimality Lemma
editorial.press_release_body: This milestone marks the first time our kernel-verified reasoning pipeline has achieved state-of-the-art performance on algebraic-geometry formalization benchmarks. editorial.unverified_gloss: For any Weierstrass curve W over a commutative ring R and any u ∈ R, if the discriminant of W's 2-torsion polynomial is a unit, then (16Δ)⁻¹u and u + 1 are relatively prime. The elliptic-curve setup is just a roundabout way of ensuring that 16Δ is invertible in R, since the 2-torsion discriminant is associated to 16Δ. Once 16Δ is a unit, (16Δ)⁻¹u divides u, and any divisor of u is automatically relatively prime to u + 1.
